missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Поезд' stays in the nominative case as the subject of 'стоит'. 'Уже' marks completion, and 'на платформе' gives the prepositional location.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Поезд' is inanimate masculine, so its accusative matches the nominative as the object of 'ждём'. 'Вечерний' agrees in the masculine accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Поезда' is in the genitive case after 'до', expressing reaching the train in time. The negated 'не успел' frames the missed connection.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'К поезду' uses the dative form 'поезду' after 'к' to express direction. 'Нашему' agrees in the masculine dative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of means. 'Поездом' is in the instrumental case expressing the means of travel without a preposition. The verb 'путешествовать' takes this naturally.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'В поезде' uses the prepositional form 'поезде' after 'в' to express where the meeting happened. The verb 'познакомились' marks the event.
Strategic focus: Nominative description. 'Поезд' is nominative as the subject. 'Быстрый' is the agreeing masculine predicate adjective, and 'очень' intensifies it.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Поезда' is the nominative plural of 'поезд', acting as the subject of 'стоят'. 'Длинные' agrees in the plural, and 'на вокзале' gives the location.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 'Поездов' is the genitive plural after 'много', expressing quantity. 'Старых' agrees in the genitive plural.
Strategic focus: Accusative after preposition. 'На поезд' uses the accusative form 'поезд' after 'на' with 'опоздали' to express missing it. 'Последний' agrees in the masculine accusative.
